summary: Flotek Industries filed an 8-K reporting that the Puerto Rico Electric Power Authority (PREPA) terminated the Power Purchase and Operating Agreement (PPOA) effective August 18, 2026. The contract, assigned from Enchanted Rock with PREPA's consent on July 31, 2026, was a 10-year deal expected to generate $40 million annual revenue and a $400 million backlog. PREPA cited two grounds: failure to furnish performance security and the Oversight Board's revocation of approval. No revenue or payments had been received, and 2026 guidance was unaffected. Watch for potential disputes or claims from termination.
